authentication: Firebase ID token; target ownership is checked server-side

request.feedback_id: client generated stable UUID; idempotency scope is the authenticated user
request.target_kind: conversation | recording; new recording_quality callers should send it, while omission first preserves recording-session compatibility and then allows an authenticated conversation-id fallback for older detail pages
request.target_id: conversation id for summary_helpfulness or recording_quality when target_kind=conversation; recording-session id when target_kind=recording
request.comment: optional bounded user text; never logged
request.client_metadata_rule: client_app_namespace is the bounded package namespace and client_app_profile is the bounded build profile; they aid cohort isolation and never authorize target access or override backend provenance
request.server_provenance_rule: These fields are read from the owned conversation/backend record. Client values cannot override them.

response.created: true for first durable write, false for idempotent retry

errors.404: target is absent or not owned by the authenticated user
errors.409: feedback_id was previously used for a different immutable payload
errors.503: durability was not confirmed; retry with the same feedback_id

privacy: The ledger stores bounded metadata and opaque pointers, never transcript or summary text.
